scope: Native x86-64 AROS QEMU, one CPU; focused SQLite fixture omits ICU only. Not full CEF profile or ARM runtime qualification.
remaining_limits: Native locking is cooperative among consumers of this versioned registry; foreign POSIX or dotfile VFS users must not concurrently access the same database.
Orderly close is tested; abrupt task death recovery remains unqualified.
One small data-only registry is retained until reboot; per-database locks and connection allocations are released on close.
